title: Tractr project
description: A single-file Tractr project (schema version 3; version 2 also loads). Generated by tools/codegen/project-schema.fsx from src/FarmEngine.Authoring/Schema.fs; do not edit. A project folder's project.json names its scenes, npcs, dialogues and items by file path instead, and its scene files hold a tileGrid in place of tiles (docs/PROJECT-FILES.md).

AchievementDefinition.description: Something to achieve (M6): unlocked the moment its conditions hold.

steamId.description: Its id on Steam, for an export with Steamworks (later).

conditions.description: All must hold for the action to run (same vocabulary as events).

failMessage.description: Shown when a condition fails; silent when empty.

outcomes.description: Applied in order when the action runs (same vocabulary as events).

energyCost.description: Energy spent on a successful run (respects the energy toggle). nonnegative.

hotkey.description: Optional single-character play-mode hotkey (max length 1). Reserved gameplay keys (movement/tools/panels) are ignored by hosts.

AllCondition.description: Every condition of the group holds (M3).

AnimalBreeding.description: How animals of a species have young (M5): each night an adult in a building with room may.

AnimalProduct.description: One more product of an animal species (M5) beside its `ProductItemId`.

minMood.description: The mood (0..100) the animal needs for it. int.

feedItemId.description: Item consumed daily; absent = grazes for free.

productIntervalDays.description: Days between products (when fed and adult). int, positive.

housing.description: Buildings its animals live in (M5, `BuildingDefinition` ids); a building that upgrades one of them counts too.

products.description: Products beside `ProductItemId` (M5), each on its own interval.

moodQualities.description: The product quality each mood earns (M5); empty: normal quality.

breeding.description: Young born in buildings with room (M5); absent: none.

mood.description: 0..100; fed & petted raise it, neglect lowers it.

buildingId.description: The building it lives in (M5: a `BuildingState` id).

moreProducts.description: Progress toward the species' `Products` (M5), by index.

lockMovement.description: An action clip (#235: `use-till-down`, `eat`, …) keeps the player in place until it ends.

impactFrame.description: An action clip's impact frame (0 = the first): the tool's effect applies when it shows; absent: at once. int, nonnegative.

effect.description: A drawing effect while the clip plays: one of `ClipEffects`.

holdItem.description: The item the action is about (eaten, held up) is drawn over the character.

AnyCondition.description: At least one condition of the group holds (M3).

AreaEffect.description: What a placed object does to the square of tiles `Radius` around it, in its scene (M5).

radius.description: Tiles in each direction (1: the 3×3 square around the object). int, 0..32.

ArtFrame.description: Rectangles are in source pixels; display size remains independent of art resolution.

AtmosphereLook.description: The look of a game's sky (M1): the day/night tint and the foliage tint. Empty or absent parts keep the look below them: a scene's look, then its season's, then the game's, then the built-in.

daylight.description: Day/night multiply-tint keyframes, linear between them, by minute of the day; empty keeps the look below.

foliageTint.description: Multiply tint of trees and weeds (`#rrggbb`); absent keeps the look below.

AtmosphereSettings.description: A game's atmosphere (M1): its look, and a look per season.

allSeasons.description: The look of every season without its own.

BuildingCondition.description: At least `Min` standing buildings of a kind, its upgrades counting (M5).

BuildingDefinition.description: A building a builder puts up (M5): a footprint on a farm scene with a door into an interior scene made from a template.

color.description: `#rrggbb`: how the game draws it without art.

door.description: The door's tile within the footprint (from its top-left corner); absent: the middle of the bottom row.

interiorSceneId.description: The scene each building of this kind gets a copy of as its interior; absent: no interior (a silo, a well).

interiorDoor.description: The interior's door: the tile that leads back out; the player arrives on the tile above it. Absent: the middle of the interior's bottom row.

buildDays.description: Nights of building before it stands; 0: done the next morning all the same. int.

scenes.description: Scenes it may be built in; empty: the farm scene (`FarmSettings.SceneId`), else the start scene.

upgradeOf.description: The building this one is an upgrade of: it is never built new, only by upgrading one of those (the house upgrades the same way).

light.description: The light its windows give at night once it stands (M8).

BuildingState.description: A building on the map (M5), from the project's start (`GameProject.Buildings`) or built in play.

id.description: Unique among the game's buildings; built ones are `building-N`.

interiorSceneId.description: The scene behind its door (empty: none yet, or no interior).

daysLeft.description: Nights of building left; 0: it stands. int.

upgradeTo.description: The building it becomes when the work under way (`DaysLeft`) is done (an upgrade).

BundleDefinition.description: A Community Center-style list of items to hand in (M6); done, it runs its outcomes (rewards, flags, an unlocked door: the world fixed).

group.description: The room or board it belongs to (the game lists bundles by group).

sceneId.description: Items are handed in only in this scene; absent: anywhere.

required.description: Lines that complete it; absent: all of them. int.

message.description: Shown when it is complete; empty: a built-in message.

BundleItem.description: A line of a bundle (M6): `Quantity` of an item, of `Quality` or better.

quality.description: The lowest crop quality it takes; absent: any.

seasons.description: Ordered list of seasons; the calendar year is the sum of their lengths.

festivals.description: Named festival days, each pinned to a season + day-of-season.

seasonId.description: Season this festival falls in (matches a CalendarSeason id).

day.description: 1-based day within that season. int, positive.

music.description: A music asset that plays all festival day (M2).

days.description: In-game days this season lasts. int, positive.

temperature.description: How warm the season is, for crops with a temperature range (M1).

music.description: A music asset that plays in the season instead of the game's own music (M2).

CharacterLayer.description: One layer of a layered character (#234): a custom asset whose clips have the same names and frame layout as the character's other layers, optionally tinted.

assetId.description: The layer's art (a custom asset id).

color.description: A `#rrggbb` the layer is multiplied with.

CollectionCondition.description: A collection holds at least `Min` items; absent `Min`: all of its items (M6).

CollectionDefinition.description: A museum, catalogue or other list of items to find (M6).

kind.description: One of `CollectionKinds`: how an item joins it.

sceneId.description: Donations are taken only in this scene (the museum); absent: anywhere.

rewards.description: In order of `Count`; each is given once.

CollectionReward.description: A reward a collection gives once it holds `Count` items (M6).

message.description: Shown when it is given; empty: none.

CombatSettings.description: Player health and fainting (M7). Absent or not `Enabled`: no health, and monsters are not spawned.

faintSceneId.description: Where the player wakes after fainting; absent: the start scene.

hurtTicks.description: Ticks after a hit during which the player takes no more damage. int.

Crop.description: A dropped/growing crop instance on a tile (game state, not content).

plantedOnDay.description: Absolute in-game day the crop was planted. int.

daysGrown.description: Watered in-game days accumulated toward growthDays.

withered.description: Killed by season change; renders dead and can be cleared.

growthDays.description: In-game days from planting to maturity. positive; validation requires it (absent or 0 grows in one day).

regrowthDays.description: In-game days between repeat harvests for regrowing crops. positive.

harvestItemId.description: The item a harvest gives. Absent: the item named `crop-{id}` (the editor's convention).

requirements.description: What it needs beyond water and its seasons (M1).

light.description: The light it gives at night once grown (M8: glowing crops).

CropMutationDefinition.description: A crop mutation (M1): a rare harvest that yields more. Mutations are checked in list order.

yieldMultiplier.description: How much more a mutated harvest yields (2 = twice). positive.

share.description: The part of a crop's mutation chance that lands on this mutation, checked in list order (the shares add up to at most 1). 0..1.

color.description: `#rrggbb`: how the editor and the game mark it.

CropQualityDefinition.description: A crop quality tier (M1). Tiers are ranked in list order, the first being the plain one.

priceMultiplier.description: Sell price multiplier (1 = the item's value). positive.

mutationMultiplier.description: Multiplies a crop's mutation chance at harvest. nonnegative.

stars.description: Stars shown after an item's name. int, nonnegative.

sheet.description: Present when the image is an animated sprite sheet (M7).

pixelsPerTile.description: How many of the image's pixels make one tile when it stands on the map (#215); absent: frames up to 32×32 fill the tile, larger ones are drawn at 32 pixels per tile. int, positive.

CustomCropDefinition.description: A project's own crop (`customCrops`): the fields of `CropDefinition`.

growthDays.description: In-game days from planting to maturity. positive; validation requires it (absent or 0 grows in one day).

regrowthDays.description: In-game days between repeat harvests for regrowing crops. positive.

harvestItemId.description: The item a harvest gives. Absent: the item named `crop-{id}` (the editor's convention).

requirements.description: What it needs beyond water and its seasons (M1).

light.description: The light it gives at night once grown (M8: glowing crops).

Cutscene.description: A cutscene (M2): steps that run over time — characters move, face and emote, the camera pans, the screen fades, music changes, lines are said and choices branch. Events start one with the `startCutscene` outcome.

skippable.description: The player may skip it (Escape); the steps it skips do nothing, except `outcomes` steps, which still run.

CutsceneChoice.description: One answer of a cutscene `choice` step: its text and the step label it jumps to.

goto.description: The label of the step to go on from; empty: the next step.

CutsceneStep.description: One step of a cutscene. Like an outcome, one flat object whose `type` (one of `CutsceneStepTypes`) says which fields apply.

label.description: A name `jump` steps and choices go to.

actor.description: Who acts: `player` or an NPC id (move, face, emote; camera follows them).

seconds.description: How long it takes, in seconds (wait, emote, camera, fade). nonnegative.

speaker.description: Who says it: `player`, an NPC id, or absent for a narrator.

expression.description: The speaker's portrait for the line (one of the NPC's `portraits`, M4).

conditions.description: A jump is taken only when all of these hold (absent: always).

soundId.description: A sound asset (sound) or music asset (music; empty: back to the game's music).

outcomes.description: Run in order (outcomes), from the outcome vocabulary.

wait.description: A move waits for the actor to arrive before the next step (absent: it waits).

animation.description: The clip an `animate` step plays on its actor (#235).

DayOfSeasonCondition.description: The day of the season within a range (M4).

DaylightKey.description: A day/night tint keyframe: at `Minute` of the day the scene is multiplied by `Color`.

color.description: `#rrggbb` multiply colour (`#ffffff` leaves the scene as drawn).

expression.description: The portrait the dialogue box shows (one of the NPC's `portraits`, M4).

eventFlag.description: Choosing this option sets this flag (true).

once.description: Only once: the option is hidden after it has been chosen (it remembers through its `EventFlag`, or a flag of its own when it has none).

hiddenIfFlag.description: The option is hidden while this flag is set.

openShopId.description: Choosing this option closes the dialogue and opens the given shop (M2).

offerQuestId.description: Choosing this option offers/starts the given quest (M3 quest-giver binding).

requiresFriendship.description: Option only shown at/above this friendship (M4 heart-gated dialogue).

actionId.description: Choosing this option performs a creator-defined action.

EnterTileCondition.description: Player entered a tile (or region when x2/y2 present).

EventOutcome.description: A single event/action outcome. Not a discriminated union: one flat object whose `type` selects which optional fields apply.

gameId.description: Stable save-folder identity; never derive it from a later project rename.

exportedIds.description: The ids the last Export Game shipped (#242): what saves of that version can hold.

ExportWindow.description: Default window for a standalone exported game.

ExportedIds.description: The ids an exported version of the game had (#242), so Problems can tell which removed ids players' saves still hold.

version.description: The game version that was exported.

FarmLayout.description: A farm map a new game can start with (M5).

sceneId.description: The scene that becomes the farm.

FarmSettings.description: The farm (M5): its scene, the layouts a new game picks from, and pests.

sceneId.description: The farm scene: buildings go here by default, and a layout replaces it.

layouts.description: Farm maps a new game picks from (two or more make the character creator ask).

pestChance.description: Chance per night that pests eat an outdoor crop no object protects, 0..1.

junkChance.description: Chance (0..1) a cast catches junk instead of rolling the table.

difficulty.description: 0..1 — harder fish escape low-tier rods more often.

FriendshipCondition.description: Friendship threshold with an NPC (M4 heart events).

sceneId.description: Scene the event lives in; empty string = evaluated in every scene.

subject.description: What the trigger is about (M3): an item (harvest, sell, craft, catch, pickUp), an NPC (friendship) or a quest (quest). Absent or empty: anything.

minute.description: The time of day a `time` trigger fires at, in minutes (M3).

eventFlags.description: Flags a new game starts with: `boolean | number | string` (plugins store numbers and strings, and Keep changes writes them back as they are), so each value is checked to be one of those.

playerLayers.description: The player as a stack of layer sheets (#234), replacing `playerVisual` when not empty.

currentDayOfSeason.description: 1-based day within `CurrentSeason` (mirrors GameState.clock.dayOfSeason). Absent when `CurrentDay` already lands on it in a calendar that starts on day 1 of the first season. int, positive.

contentPacks.description: Installed content packs (M5). Array order = load order.

scripts.description: The creator's own scripts (#241): trusted plugins of the game itself, which use the game's ids as written.

terrains.description: The project's terrains (M1), beside and over the built-in ones.

tools.description: The project's tools (M1), beside and over the built-in ones.

itemCategories.description: The project's item categories (M1), beside and over the built-in ones.

cropQualities.description: The project's crop qualities (M1), beside and over the built-in tiers.

cropMutations.description: The project's crop mutations (M1), beside and over the built-in ones.

buildings.description: Buildings on the map when a game starts (M5: the house; Keep changes adds built ones).

saveMigrations.description: Rules for saves written before a game update (#242), compiled into the content.

testStates.description: Named states a playtest can start from (#229); never compiled into a cartridge.

export.description: Optional native export identity, window and target settings (additive to schema v8).

rngState.description: Serialized PRNG state so play sessions resume deterministically (additive, optional).

socialState.description: Friendship & gifting state per NPC (mirrors GameState.social).

mineDeepestFloor.description: Deepest mine floor reached (mirrors GameState.mine.deepestFloor). int, nonnegative.

quarantinedItems.description: Items whose owning pack is missing/disabled (mirrors GameState.quarantinedItems).

keptState.description: The rest of a kept playtest's state (Rust `KeptState`: tick, open dialogue, shop, minigame or cutscene, chosen music, today's shop purchases, NPC walks, mine floor, children, changed shop stock, and the M5–M7 `goals`: open storage, the farm layout, the shipping log, collections, bundles, achievements, mail, monsters and health). Only the engine reads it.

GameWords.description: The words of a game (M1): what it calls money, energy and the skills, in every language.

money.description: How an amount of money is written, `{0}` standing for the number (`${0}`, `{0} credits`).

locales.description: The same words in other languages, by locale code (their own `Locales` are not read).

GridPoint.description: An integer tile coordinate: TS inline `{ x: int, y: int }` objects in `NPCSchema.patrolPoints` and `NpcStateSchema.path`.

GrowthRequirements.description: What a crop needs to be planted and to grow, beyond water and its seasons (M1).

terrains.description: Terrains it can be planted on; empty: any plantable terrain.

light.description: One of `LightNeeds`: `light` (no terrain on its tile blocks light, and the scene is not dark) or `dark`; absent: either.

minTemperature.description: The coolest it grows at (`Scene.Temperature`, else the season's).

sceneTags.description: Scene tags it needs, all of them (`Scene.Tags`).

fertilizers.description: Fertilizer items it must be planted with (one of them); empty: none needed.

neighbors.description: Neighbours it needs around its tile.

HeartEvent.description: A cutscene that plays once when the player has enough hearts with an NPC (M4).

sceneId.description: Where it plays: on entering this scene. Absent or empty: when the player talks to the NPC.

conditions.description: More conditions (the events'); an empty `npcId` is the event's NPC.

HeartsCondition.description: Whole hearts with an NPC within a range (M4); an empty `NpcId` is the NPC the player is talking to.

InteractTileCondition.description: Player interacted while facing a tile (or region).

quality.description: The crop quality of the units in this slot (one of `CropQualities` other than normal); absent for normal quality.

type.description: An item category id (`ItemCategoryDefinition`; the built-in ones are `ItemTypes`).

toolType.description: A tool id (`ToolDefinition`; the built-in ones are `ToolTypes`).

toolTier.description: Tool tier: 1 = basic. Higher tiers hit harder, cost less energy, gain AoE. int, positive.

useActionId.description: Action performed when the item is used from the inventory.

consumeOnUse.description: Consume one of the item on a successful use.

energy.description: Energy it restores when eaten, for an edible kind (M1); absent: the kind's.

wear.description: The item is clothing the player can wear (M4).

health.description: Health it restores when eaten, with combat on (M7). int.

ItemCategoryDefinition.description: A kind of item (M1) and what items of it do. The built-in kinds are seed, tool, crop, gift, quest, fertilizer, material, fish and food (edible, for the item's own energy).

plantable.description: Planted on soil (the item's `CropType` says what grows).

fertilizer.description: Planted with a seed to fertilize its soil.

equippable.description: Held and used as a tool (the item's `ToolType`): it wears down and shops repair it.

edible.description: Eaten from the inventory for energy.

energy.description: Energy an item of it restores when eaten (the item's `Energy` replaces it). nonnegative.

placeable.description: Put down in the world (a machine type names the item).

LightSource.description: A light that glows at night (M8): lamps, glowing crops, lit windows. Drawn by the game, never read by the simulation.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, in tiles. int, 1..16.

brightness.description: How strong it is at its centre, in percent. int, 1..100.

MachineProcessing.description: TS `TileMachineSchema.processing` (inline object): an in-flight machine job.

itemId.description: Item consumed to place this machine (crafted or bought).

stationCategories.description: Station categories a placed machine of this type provides to nearby hand-crafting (e.g. a Kitchen provides 'cooking').

storage.description: Slots of storage: a chest (M5). Absent: none (a shipping bin has `FarmSchema.DefaultShippingSlots`). int, nonnegative.

shipping.description: A shipping bin (M6): what it holds is sold overnight. Absent: not one.

gate.description: A gate (M5): interacting opens and closes it, and an open gate never blocks.

areaEffects.description: What it does to the tiles around it (M5): sprinklers, scarecrows.

light.description: The light it gives at night (M8).

MailDefinition.description: A letter (M6). It arrives in the morning: after a `sendMail` outcome or a quest that sends it, or by itself on a morning its `Conditions` hold (an NPC at some hearts, a birthday).

from.description: The NPC who writes it; empty: no sender (or the text says).

attachments.description: Items in the envelope, taken when it is read.

outcomes.description: Run when it is first read.

conditions.description: It arrives by itself on a morning these hold; empty: only when sent.

repeat.description: It may come again (each morning its conditions hold; a birthday letter every year).

rocks.description: Weighted node types spawned in this depth band.

density.description: Rock density (fraction of floor tiles occupied). 0..1.

monsterCount.description: Monsters per floor (M7), with combat on; absent: none. int.

hazards.description: Hazard terrains scattered over its floors (M7).

treasure.description: Weighted treasure left on its floors (M7).

treasureCount.description: Treasures per floor (M7); absent: none. int.

entranceSceneId.description: Scene holding the mine entrance (descend via the entrance tile).

ladderChance.description: Chance a broken rock reveals the ladder down. 0..1.

elevatorEvery.description: Elevator checkpoint every N floors. int, positive.

MineFloorCondition.description: The deepest mine floor reached is at least `Min` (M6).

MineHazard.description: A hazard terrain a mine depth band scatters over its floors (M7), on the overlay layer.

MineMonsterWeight.description: A weighted monster of a mine depth band (M7).

MineRockWeight.description: TS `MineBandSchema.rocks` item (inline object): a weighted node type.

MineTreasure.description: A weighted treasure of a mine depth band (M7): an item left on a floor tile.

kind.description: Implementation key looked up in the host's minigame registry ('timing-bar' ships with the engine; game code registers custom kinds). Unknown kinds fall back to a neutral confirm that scores 0.5.

config.description: Kind-specific tuning, passed verbatim to the implementation (`z.unknown()` values).

resultTiers.description: Declarative consequences by score tier (highest matching minScore).

minScore.description: Tier applies when score ≥ minScore; the highest matching tier wins. 0..1.

MoneyCondition.description: The player has at least `Min` money (M6).

color.description: `#rrggbb`: how the game draws it without art.

damage.description: Health the player loses when it touches them. int, nonnegative.

defense.description: Taken off every hit it takes (a hit always does at least 1). int, nonnegative.

sight.description: How near (tiles) the player must come for a chaser to notice them. int.

drops.description: Rolled when it is slain, like a node's drops.

experience.description: Combat experience for slaying it. int.

MonsterSpawn.description: Monsters a scene has each morning (M7): `Count` of a monster on free tiles of the area (`X..=X2`, `Y..=Y2`; absent ends: the whole scene).

MoodQuality.description: A product quality an animal's mood earns (M5): the best tier whose `MinMood` it has.

playerSpeed.description: Player walk speed in tiles per second (free movement). positive.

NeighborRequirement.description: Weighted drop-table entry for a gathering node. Neighbours a crop needs around its tile: crops of a type, a terrain, or water.

kind.description: One of `NeighborKinds`: `crop`, `terrain` or `water` (a terrain that is a water source).

id.description: The crop type or terrain id; unused for water.

radius.description: How far to look, in tiles (1 = the eight tiles around). int, positive.

min.description: How many matching tiles are needed. int, positive.

NodeTypeDefinition.description: A gathering node type (tree, rock, weeds, …) — content-defined so mods and projects can add their own.

health.description: Number of tool hits required to break the node. int, positive.

requiredToolTier.description: Minimum tool tier required (tools default to tier 1). int, positive.

drops.description: Weighted drop table; each hit that depletes the node rolls once per entry range.

blocksMovement.description: Whether the node blocks movement while present.

light.description: The light it gives at night while standing (M8).

NotCondition.description: None of the conditions of the group holds (M3).

wanderRadius.description: Max tiles from home for the wander pattern (default 3). int, positive.

patrolPoints.description: Waypoints for the patrol pattern (visited in order, looping).

schedule.description: Time-based schedule (M3): sorted by minute; latest passed entry wins.

giftTastes.description: Gift preferences (M4 social); unlisted items are neutral.

birthday.description: Birthday: day-of-season (1-28) within birthSeason, doubles gift effects.

lines.description: What the NPC says when the player talks to it, by day (M4): see `NpcLine`.

portraits.description: Portraits by expression for the dialogue box (M4).

romanceable.description: The NPC can be dated and married, when the game allows it (M4).

look.description: Colours for the built-in base character (#216): an NPC with a look and no art of its own is drawn as the base character in these colours.

layers.description: The NPC as a stack of layer sheets (#234), drawn in order; replaces its visual and built-in art when not empty.

NpcLine.description: A line an NPC may say when the player talks to it (M4): in place of its first dialogue's text, on days when its conditions hold. Lines whose conditions hold share the day by weight.

conditions.description: The events' conditions; an empty `npcId` in `hearts` and `relationship` is this NPC.

expression.description: The portrait the dialogue box shows with the line (one of the NPC's `portraits`).

weight.description: How often the line comes up next to the others that hold (absent: 1). int.

NpcPortrait.description: A portrait an NPC shows in the dialogue box for an expression (M4).

expression.description: `happy`, `sad`… any name; lines, dialogues and cutscene lines pick it by this name.

NpcScheduleVariant.description: A scheduled destination: at `minute` (of day), head to (sceneId, x, y).

talkedDay.description: The last day the player talked to the NPC (M4: friendship decay). int.

status.description: Dating, engaged or married (M4, one of `RelationshipStatuses`); absent: single.

statusDay.description: The day `Status` began; for an engagement, the wedding day. int.

terrains.description: Terrains the pack adds or replaces (M11).

tools.description: Tools the pack adds or replaces (M11).

itemCategories.description: Item categories the pack adds or replaces (M11).

cropQualities.description: Crop quality tiers the pack adds or replaces (M11).

cropMutations.description: Crop mutations the pack adds or replaces (M11).

cutscenes.description: Cutscenes the pack adds or replaces (M11).

heartEvents.description: Heart events the pack adds or replaces (M4).

buildingTypes.description: Building types the pack adds or replaces (M9: the M5 content).

collections.description: Collections the pack adds or replaces (M9: the M6 content).

bundles.description: Bundles the pack adds or replaces (M9).

achievements.description: Achievements the pack adds or replaces (M9).

mail.description: Letters the pack adds or replaces (M9).

monsters.description: Monsters the pack adds or replaces (M9: the M7 content).

gamePanels.description: Game panels the pack adds (M9), shown only with `permissions.uiPanels`.

strings.description: Per-locale string tables for game text (M7 i18n). Keys address content fields: `item:{id}:name`, `item:{id}:description`, `dialogue:{id}:text`, `quest:{id}:name`, `quest:{id}:description`. The authored text is the fallback locale.

PackInstallation.description: How a project stores an installed pack. Array order = load order.

base.description: Base packs (content-default) keep their plain IDs; all other packs get their definitions namespaced to `packId:localId` at load time.

overrides.description: Fully-qualified IDs this pack intentionally replaces. Redefining an existing ID without declaring it here is a conflict surfaced in the Problems panel (the earlier definition wins).

hooks.description: Hook names the pack's plugins may subscribe to (user-approved at install).

contentInject.description: May contribute content definitions, a player start and string tables (the normal case). When off, none of the pack's content loads; its plugins still run.

uiPanels.description: May add game panels (`content.gamePanels`, M9): shown after the game's own, whatever `contentInject` says.

mutations.description: Mutation capabilities the pack's plugins may use (`message`, `giveItem`, `setFlag:any`, `*`, … — see docs/PLUGINS.md). None: the defaults, and onEffect/onCommand answers are dropped.

minigames.description: Minigame kinds the pack's plugins may define (user-approved at install), by local name (`lantern-catch`); minigame defs play one as `packId:name` (docs/PLUGINS.md). None and empty both allow none.

read.description: What the pack's plugins may read of the game (#237): `player`, `world`, `people`, `content`, and `any` for the game's and other packs' flags. None and empty allow no reads.

entities.description: Entity types the pack's plugins may define (#238), by local name.

itemUses.description: Item-use handlers the pack's plugins may define (#238), by local name.

screens.description: Game screens the pack's plugins may add (#240), by local name.

PackPlayerStart.description: Optional player-start block so a base pack can express the whole starter game.

PackPlugin.description: A sandboxed plugin: `source` is the body of `function (api) { ... }` and registers handlers with `api.on(hookName, fn)`. Handlers return an array of mutations (validated as `PluginMutation`) — never raw state access.

hooks.description: Hooks this plugin wants; effective set = intersection with manifest permissions.hooks.

minigames.description: Minigame kinds this plugin defines (`api.minigame(name, …)`), by local name; effective set = intersection with manifest permissions.minigames.

conditions.description: Conditions this plugin defines (`api.condition(name, …)`, #239), with their argument forms.

entities.description: Entity types this plugin defines (`api.entity`, #238); effective set = intersection with manifest permissions.entities.

itemUses.description: Item-use handlers this plugin defines (`api.itemUse`, #238); effective set = intersection with manifest permissions.itemUses.

screens.description: Game screens this plugin adds (`api.screen`, #240); effective set = intersection with manifest permissions.screens.

PerkCondition.description: The player's level in a skill is at least `Min` (M6).

Player.description: The project's player start/record (TS `PlayerSchema`); runtime uses `PlayerState`.

skills.description: Per-category skill XP/levels (M4g); mirrored from GameState on save.

name.description: The player's name (M4; a new game may ask for it).

look.description: How the player looks (M4); absent: the built-in look.

worn.description: The clothes the player wears (M4), one per slot.

health.description: Health (M7, with combat on); absent: full. int.

PlayerLook.description: The player character's colours (M4): `#rrggbb` each; absent ones keep the built-in art's.

PluginArgument.description: One argument of a plugin condition or outcome (#239).

kind.description: For an `id`: the content it names (`item`, `npc`, `quest`, …).

PluginCondition.description: Today is an NPC's birthday; an empty `NpcId`: anyone's (M6). A plugin condition (#239): what the pack plugin that defines `Condition` (`packId:name`, or a project script's plain name) answers for `Args`. False without that plugin.

PluginFunction.description: A condition or outcome a plugin defines (#239): its local name, how the editor shows it, and its arguments.

PluginScreen.description: A game screen a plugin adds (#240): its local name, its title, and an optional hotkey.

ProjectScript.description: A project script (#241): JavaScript of the game itself (one `scripts/<id>.js` file in a project folder), with a pack plugin's API but trusted. Its plugin id is `script/<id>`.

disabled.description: Off: the script does not run.

collapseEnergyFraction.description: Fraction of energy restored after a collapse (vs full sleep). 0..1.

collapseMoneyPenalty.description: Money penalty charged on collapse. nonnegative.

calendar.description: Creator-configurable calendar (M9): seasons, their lengths, and festival days.

skillsEnabled.description: Player skills (M4g): XP per action category, levels unlock recipes.

locale.description: Game-text locale (M7 i18n): packs may carry per-locale string tables.

showMadeWithCredit.description: Optional, creator-controlled credit shown in exported games.

words.description: What the game calls money, energy and the skills (M1); absent: the built-in words.

atmosphere.description: The day/night and foliage tints (M1); absent: the built-in look.

relationships.description: Friendship decay, dating, marriage and children (M4); absent: none of them.

characterCreator.description: A new game asks for the player's name, the farm's name and the player's colours (M4).

farm.description: The farm scene, its layouts and pests (M5); absent: no layouts, no pests.

combat.description: Player health, monsters and fainting (M7); absent: no combat.

scripts.description: Budgets of the project's own scripts (#241); None: the pack plugin defaults.

availableSeasons.description: Seasonal availability (M3): quest only offered/auto-started in these seasons.

availableFromDay.description: Absolute-day window (M3): offered from/until these days (inclusive).

skill.description: The skill `Experience` goes to (farming, mining, foraging, fishing, social, …). Absent: farming.

mailId.description: A letter sent on completion (M6), arriving the next morning.

processingMinutes.description: In-game minutes a machine needs; 0 = instant hand-craft. nonnegative.

machineTypeId.description: Machine type required; absent = craftable by hand.

category.description: Freeform crafting discipline for UI grouping ('cooking', 'magic', 'carpentry', …).

requiresStationCategory.description: Hand-craftable only while near a machine providing this station category.

skill.description: Requires a skill at a minimum level.

RelationshipCondition.description: The player's relationship with an NPC (M4), one of `RelationshipStatuses`; an empty `NpcId` is the NPC the player is talking to, else anyone.

RelationshipSettings.description: A game's relationship rules (M4). Every part is off until the creator turns it on.

decayPerDay.description: Friendship points an NPC loses on a day the player neither talked to it nor gave it a gift (0: no decay). int.

datingHearts.description: Hearts a romanceable NPC needs before it accepts the dating gift. int.

datingItemId.description: The gift that asks to date (absent: dating starts at the hearts by itself).

proposalHearts.description: Hearts a dated NPC needs before it accepts the proposal. int.

proposalItemId.description: The gift that proposes (needed for marriage).

weddingDays.description: Days from the engagement to the wedding. int.

homeSceneId.description: Where a spouse lives (absent: the spouse keeps its own place).

spouseHelps.description: A spouse helps each morning: waters the crops, feeds the animals or brings a gift.

spouseGiftItemIds.description: What a spouse may bring in the morning.

childDays.description: Days married before a child arrives, and between children. int.

childNames.description: Names the children get, in order.

RngState.description: Serialized PRNG state — deterministic resume is a core guarantee.

algorithm.description: Always `"xoshiro128ss"` (zod literal). Any value decodes (a non-string to `""`): the checks report the literal ("Invalid literal value", SchemaChecks.fs), as zod does.

SaveMigration.description: A rule a game update carries for saves written before it (#242): an old item or scene id renamed (`To`), an item replaced by `Quantity` of another, or removed and paid for (`Money` a unit). Applied when such a save loads, while the game has no content under `From`.

quantity.description: Units of `To` for each unit of `From` (items). int, positive.

money.description: Gold paid for each unit of a removed item (items without `To`).

x.description: Where a player in a moved scene lands (scenes; their own tile when absent). int.

name.description: The old name, for the notice players read.

indoor.description: Indoor scenes (greenhouses, interiors, mine floors) keep the weather out: rain does not water their soil and storms do not damage their crops. Absent means outdoor.

dark.description: No daylight reaches its crops (caves), for crops that need light or dark (M1).

temperature.description: How warm it is, for crops with a temperature range (M1); absent: the season's.

atmosphere.description: Its own day/night and foliage tints (M1).

music.description: A music asset that plays in the scene (M2).

allSeasons.description: Crops are planted and grow here in every season (a greenhouse, M5).

building.description: The building whose interior this is (M5: a `BuildingState` id; the engine sets it).

layers.description: Its extra layers beyond background, overlay and object, in drawing order (M8).

forageSpawns.description: Forage that spawns in it each morning.

SceneCondition.description: The player is in one of these scenes (M3).

SceneLayer.description: An extra layer of a scene (M8), painted with terrains like the three fixed layers: drawn over the object layer, or (`Above`) over the player and everything standing. Scenery: it never blocks and is never farmed.

above.description: Drawn over the player and everything standing; absent: over the object layer.

locked.description: Locked transitions don't fire; events can lock/unlock them (M3).

ScriptSettings.description: Budgets of a project's scripts (#241), in fuel (docs/PLUGINS.md "Limits"); None keeps the pack plugin default.

ShippedCondition.description: At least `Min` units shipped of an item; an empty `ItemId`: of everything (M6).

sellPriceMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to item base value when the player sells here.

buysItems.description: Whether this shop buys player items at all.

repairsTools.description: Whether this shop repairs broken tools (for durability * repairCostPerPoint).

buildings.description: Buildings it builds and upgrades (M5): a builder.

ShopStockEntry.description: A single line in a shop's stock list.

price.description: Override price; defaults to the item's base value.

seasons.description: Restrict availability to these seasons (empty/absent = always).

dailyLimit.description: Max units purchasable per in-game day (absent = unlimited). int, positive.

SlainCondition.description: At least `Min` monsters slain of a kind; an empty `MonsterId`: of any (M7).

SpriteSheet.description: Sprite-sheet slicing metadata (M7). A sheet is a grid: columns = walk frames, rows = directions (down, left, right, up) when `directional`. Assets without this stay static images; games with zero art still render via the colored-rectangle fallback.

TerrainDefinition.description: Live machine instance on a tile. A kind of ground, path or object a tile can be (M1), and its rules. The built-in terrains are grass, soil, water, path, wall, door and floor.

layer.description: One of `TileLayers`: the layer a tile of it is painted on.

color.description: `#rrggbb`: the editor's swatch, and how the game draws it without art.

walkable.description: The player and NPCs can walk on it.

waterSource.description: Counts as water for crops that need water nearby.

fishable.description: The fishing action works on it.

blocksLight.description: A crop on a tile of it gets no light.

hazardEnergy.description: Energy the player loses on stepping onto it. nonnegative.

indoor.description: Keeps the weather off its tile, as an indoor scene does (greenhouse floors).

damage.description: Health the player loses on stepping onto it, with combat on (M7); absent: none. int, nonnegative.

autotile.description: Joins up with its neighbours of the same terrain (M8): with art, frame `n` of its `autotile` clip, where `n` adds 1 for the same terrain above, 2 right, 4 below and 8 left; without art, its edges are drawn where it meets another terrain.

tall.description: On the object layer: how many tiles it rises above its own (M8), drawn standing, in front of what is behind it and behind what is in front. int, 0..8.

light.description: The light it gives at night (M8).

TerrainTransform.description: A terrain change a tool makes.

action.description: One of `ToolActions`: the action that makes the change (`till`, `transform` or `break`).

tool.description: Only this tool makes it; absent: every tool with the action.

into.description: The terrain it becomes; empty removes an overlay or object.

TestState.description: A named game state a playtest or a headless run starts from (#229), applied after New Game on the current content. Everything is optional: what a state leaves out stays as New Game made it. Quest statuses are set as they are (no rewards or outcomes run).

day.description: Absolute day (1 is the first day). int, positive.

time.description: Minute of the day (480 is 8:00). int.

x.description: The player's tile (the scene's centre when absent). int.

variables.description: Variables: flags holding a number or a text.

quests.description: Quest statuses by quest id (one of `QuestStatuses`).

friendship.description: Friendship points by NPC id (125 a heart). int.

inventory.description: The whole inventory, replacing New Game's.

quality.description: A crop quality other than normal.

background.description: Background layer: grass, soil, water, floor

overlay.description: Overlay layer: path, rug, … renders on top of background

object.description: Object layer: wall, door, … renders on top of overlay

node.description: Gathering node instance (tree/rock/…) occupying this tile.

ladderDown.description: Mine ladder going down (M4 mining, generated floors).

decor.description: The terrain painted on each of the scene's extra layers (`Scene.Layers`, M8), by layer id.

processing.description: In-flight job: recipe + absolute game-minute it completes.

contents.description: What a chest or shipping bin holds (M5).

TileNode.description: Live node instance state stored on a tile.

depletedOnDay.description: Set when depleted; used for respawn scheduling. int.

dayStartMinute.description: Minute-of-day the player wakes up (6:00). int.

dayEndMinute.description: Minute-of-day the player collapses if still awake (26:00 = 2am). int.

minutesPerRealSecond.description: In-game minutes that pass per real-time second. positive, at most 1440.

pauseInModals.description: Whether the clock stops while a dialogue, shop, minigame or menu is open. Absent means on; v8 ran the clock on.

dayMinutes.description: Minutes in a day (M1); absent: 1440. int, at least 60.

ToolArea.description: The area a tool covers at one tier: `Width` tiles across the player's facing, `Length` tiles ahead.

width.description: Odd widths centre on the faced tile. int, positive.

ToolDefinition.description: A tool (M1): what it does, what it costs and its key. The built-in tools are the watering can, hoe, axe, pickaxe, scythe and fishing rod.

action.description: One of `ToolActions`: water, till, harvest, fish, break, transform, place, plant or attack (a weapon, M7: the item's `ToolPower` is the damage). Any tool strikes the gathering node it faces.

key.description: The play-mode key that uses it (one character); absent: none.

energyCost.description: Energy a tier 1 use costs; each tier above costs 15% less. nonnegative.

area.description: The area it covers by tier (the first entry is tier 1, the last covers the tiers above).

skill.description: The skill that gains experience when it breaks a node; absent: foraging.

placeTerrain.description: The terrain the `place` action puts down.

VariableCondition.description: A variable (a flag holding a number or text, M3) compared with a number (`Value`) or, when `Text` is set, with a text.

WearDefinition.description: Where and how a piece of clothing is worn (M4).

color.description: The colour it gives the shirt, the trousers or the hat (`#rrggbb`).

visual.description: Art drawn over the player (a hat), facing like the player.

layer.description: A layer sheet (a custom asset id, #234) drawn over the character while worn, with the same clips and frame layout as the character's art; tinted with `color` when set.

table.description: Per-season weighted roll tables (rolled at each day start).

overlays.description: The game's own overlays (M1), beside and over the built-in rain and snow.

WeatherOverlayDefinition.description: How a weather looks on screen (M1): particles and a tint. The built-in overlays are rain and snow.

style.description: One of `OverlayStyles`: `rain` (streaks), `snow` (flakes), `dust` (drifting specks) or `none` (the tint only).

density.description: Particles relative to the built-in amount. nonnegative.

speed.description: Speed relative to the built-in style. nonnegative.

tint.description: `#rrggbb` multiplied over the scene while it falls; absent: none.

watersOutdoorSoil.description: Rain-like: outdoor soil is watered automatically at day start.

cropDamageChance.description: Chance (0..1) each outdoor crop is destroyed overnight (storms).

npcsStayInside.description: NPCs with schedules stay home (skip schedule walking).

overlay.description: The overlay it shows (a `WeatherOverlayDefinition` id: `rain`, `snow` or the game's own) or null.

music.description: A music asset that plays in this weather, outdoors (M2).

WeekdayCondition.description: Today is the named festival (M9 calendar).
